blurb: Heritage Irish Stepdancers offers Irish dance classes for all ages with an emphasis on small class sizes and individual attention. Students can participate in performances and competitions, though these are optional. The school provides costume and shoe options including used and rental items to keep costs affordable.
extraNote: No requirement to upgrade to fancier costume at any level · Performances and competitions are optional
